description: Presidential Secretariat -  Declare  that Public Security  Ordinance come into operation throughout Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette contains a proclamation by the President declaring a state of public emergency and bringing into operation Part II of the Public Security Ordinance. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action involving the implementation of emergency powers under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
